correctness.rationale: The path-interface argument supplies exactly m independent Bernoulli captures despite arbitrary side-branch event interleavings; attached subtrees have deterministic colors. For equal rates, strict covariance positivity forces all available extras inside, positive-definite indicator covariance forces maximizers to concentrate on one interior path position, and symmetric binomial monotonicity identifies exactly the central index/indices. The minimum and equality characterizations follow from strictly positive covariances. Standalone exact-rational CTMC recurrences agree in 75 cases; all 4,970 small parameter/component compositions meet exact bounds and equality cases; no finite enumeration is presented as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The number of peripheral contacts, their root attachment and the seed spacing are natural identifiable structural parameters in competitive irreversible spreading. The result completely and sharply determines both extremes of outcome-size uncertainty for all finite tree shapes, with equality classification and robust invariance under off-path edge rates. For m=3 and four peripheral vertices, topology alone changes variance from 3/4 to 31/4, a substantive order-of-magnitude separation without changing total size, path distance or path rates. It is not merely a single arbitrary computed number.
